title: Late Cancellation and No-Show Hours Schedule, Personal Services Plan
content:
For each tier of the Personal Services Plan this schedule states the notice period below which a cancellation of a booked service visit is late, the hours drawn or billed for a late cancellation, and the hours drawn or billed when staff arrive and the resident declines the service or is absent (a no-show).

| Tier | Late-cancellation notice period (hours before the scheduled start) | Late-cancellation hours (hours) | No-show hours (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan | 24 | 1.0 | 1.0 |
| Personal Services Essentials Package | 24 | 1.0 | 1.0 |
| Personal Services Companion Package | 24 | 1.0 | 1.0 |
| Personal Services Comfort Package | 24 | 1.0 | 1.0 |
| Personal Services Premier Package | 24 | 0.5 | 1.0 |
| Personal Services Concierge Package | 24 | 0.0 | 0.5 |

## Notes to the schedule

- The notice period is 24 hours on every tier.
- The late-cancellation hours fall from 1.0 hour on the first four tiers to 0.5 hour on the Premier Package and 0.0 hours on the Concierge Package.
- The no-show hours are 1.0 hour on every tier except the Concierge Package, where they are 0.5 hour.
